Veterans dominated the men's section of the field and both Fred Riach and Don Anderson ran well to pick up the minor prizes with Veteran's Team Manager Tony Binda proving to be fastest of the day.

It's some time ago now, August 2001 to be precise, but we must record the valiant action of Fred Riach. Enjoying his Monday afternoon jog through Battersea Park, Fred Riach was galvanised into action when he heard a splash and saw a two year-old girl struggling face down in the lake.
